summary: G. Willi-Food International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointments of Mr. Erez Wiener and Mr. Daniel Schutz as directors, effective July 1, 2026, until the next AGM. Mr. Wiener previously served as CEO of the company; Mr. Schutz is the son-in-law of the CEO and controlling shareholder. This is a voluntary board refreshment, not a forced departure, and no immediate activist or strategic catalyst is stated. The filing is a routine disclosure for a foreign private issuer, with no deal terms or premium. Watch for any subsequent AGM matters or shareholder reaction.
